articleTitle: A method of leg skin recognition based on distribution of skin texture
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: Identifying the criminal and victims in images with only parts of skin existing is a new and challenging task. For this situation, the individual recognition in tradition is invalid, because there are not obvious features existing in the skin images, especially in some forensic cases, there are neither faces nor body labels can be observed. To address this problem, some methods based on skin mark pattern and blood vessel pattern are proposed, however, these methods neglected a fact that the image is not always high resolution, skin marks and blood vessel are not reliable sometimes. A recent paper indicated that androgenic hair patterns are effective in low resolution, but the alignment is not considered and the matching is not robust to viewpoint changing. In this paper, a new feature pattern based on distribution of skin texture trend which firstly borrows the conception of contour line in geography is proposed. A sliding block system is designed to increase discrimination ability and robustness to rotation. Different legs with resolution of 25, 18.75, 12.5, 6.25, 2.60 and 1.30 dpi were examined. Experiment results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm is effective and has rotation invariance, which has a certain improvement.

articleTitle: Application of cerebellar model articulation controller in permanent magnet synchronous
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: In order to improve the system's rapidity, robustness and anti-interference ability, in the permanent magnet synchronous motor closed-loop speed control system, using the model of cerebellar speed loop neural network and PID control. Cerebellum model articulation controller (CMAC) can learn a variety of nonlinear functions, and the number of iterations of the neural network is much less than the conventional BP neural network. In order to verify the effectiveness of the cerebellum model and PID compound control (CMAC-PID) method, the proposed method is verified on the MATLAB simulation platform. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional PI control, the CMAC-PID control system has the advantages of small overshoot, more stable system and better robustness and disturbance rejection performance.

articleTitle: The application of intelligent control algorithm in sanitation monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of the management of the City garbage data, based on the project of monitoring sanitation system, an intelligent control algorithm is designed to realize the fast and efficient transmission of the whole network data and the balance of the consumption of energy. The LEACH clustering algorithm is optimized for the situation of unequal energy loss in data transmission, in the process of path selection, considering the residual energy and the distribution of the node. By training of the neural network, the original path selection is optimized. Then, for the reasonable judgment for the emergency events under the influence of many factors, the fuzzy control algorithm is added during the process of data fusion. The simulation results show that, the consumption of the energy can achieve a balance. After some rounds of communication, obviously, the number of surviving nodes is more and the effects of the results of the judgment is good.

articleTitle: Design and realization of intelligent tracker based on vision and bluetooth
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: Aiming at the need of autonomous patrol driving, an intelligent car system design scheme is proposed. The design of intelligent car hardware system is introduced as follows, including power module, image acquisition module, motor drive module, speed acquisition module. At the same time, a black line recognition algorithm based on CMOS camera is proposed, and its corresponding control strategy is introduced in detail. Finally, in order to improve the speed and stability of the car, it uses Bluetooth and 2.4G, SD card and the host computer and other debugging tools, a lot of hardware and software testing are carried out. The designed intelligent car tracing system can quickly and accurately analyze the path and arrange path, which can accurately complete the autonomous tracking, with simple, efficient, good real-time and advantages.

articleTitle: An optimal sampling-based path planning under uncertainty based on linear quadratic regulator
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: The navigation of mobile robots is affected by noises from perceptual systems and positioning systems, as well as track deviations from control systems. Therefore, it is significant to ensure the stability of path planning in an uncertain environment. In this paper, an optimal samplingbased path planning method based on linear quadratic regulator is proposed. This method uses heuristic rapid-exploring random tree to generate paths which are executable and asymptotic optimal. Then, the priori distributions of the generated paths are calculated and evaluated through an uncertainty factor. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation experiments in a variety of uncertain environments.

articleTitle: Bounded semantics based correctness checking for extended ECTL* properties
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: Bounded model checking based on bounded semantics is an efficient method for finding errors in system designs. The basic idea of the bounded semantics for temporal logics (or fragments of such logics) is to consider bounded paths (possibly with loops) instead of all of the infinite ones. In this paper, we further study bounded semantics of extended ECTL∗ (eECTL∗) formulas which allows some sort of fairness that are not supported by some well known model checkers such as Spin and NuSMV. A QBF encoding of this logic is then developed from the definition of the bounded semantics. Finally, we propose a bounded correctness checking algorithm for eECTL∗ formulas and apply the bounded semantics of eECTL∗ to derive a QBF-based characterization of eECTL∗ properties.

articleTitle: Order analysis of diesel engine in accelerating stage based on void — Kalman method
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: The vibration signal of diesel engine during the accelerating status have obvious non-stationary characteristics. The collected vibration signals can used to extract the frequency of engine body. In this paper, a novel method that combine the Vold-Kalman filter order tracking method and EEMD is proposed, which can extract the typical vibration frequency and transient characteristics of vibration signals from diesel engine body. Firstly, the collected vibration signal must be preprocessed by detrending and denoising. Then, the Vold-Kalman method is used to extract the order of vibration signal and reconstruct the vibration signal. The reconstructed signal decompose by EEMD method and the typical IMF is selected by the maximum entropy criterion. Finally, the selected IMF is used to extract typical characteristics and instantaneous frequency energy distribution. This method can refer to understand the engine vibrating feature during the accelerating stage by extracting the main vibration frequency.

articleTitle: Image guided as-assembled car engine sealing surface modeling
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: In the car engine, the sealing performance of sealing surface is directly related to the performance of the machine. To ensure sealing, machining and assembly accuracy of the seal plane must be strictly controlled in the engine assembly process. However, it is difficult to measure the surface topography on the sealing plane and the spatial position between the two mating surfaces accurately. Furthermore, it's also not easy to ensure that the measurement time must meet the production rhythm of the assembly line. In order to overcome the above technical challenges, this paper proposes an image-guided point cloud registration method and then uses the registered point cloud to virtually measure the car engine sealing status and thus helps to evaluate the assembly quality. Firstly, get the point cloud of the engine's sealing surface via the High-Definition Metrology system. Secondly, the feature lines from the guidance image of the sealing surface are exacted. Thirdly, register the two-point cloud models with the help of guidance images. The experiments of assembly measurement on an engine head-deck faces verify the efficacy.

articleTitle: Modeling of shape memory alloy actuator based on hammerstein model
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: Shape memory alloy (SMA) is a promising smart metallic material, which has the ability to recover its shape when heated. This interesting characteristic enables SMA to serve as an alternative to replace conventional actuators. This brief introduces a novel modeling scheme for SMA actuators. The nonlinear plant is described as an Hammerstein blockoriented model. The model parameters are identified by the recursive least squares algorithm, which is usable for online modeling and real-time control. The convergence property of the parameter estimation can be guaranteed in the presence of persistent excitation. Experimental results have shown that the modeling scheme is effective. Its comparison with a mechanism model has demonstrated the merits of an Hammerstein model.

articleTitle: Research on patent mapping of technology in linear motor based on machine tool manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: Using IPC (International Patent Classification) classification method and data collection[1], patent information hiding in the technological field of the numerical linear motor based on machine tool manufacturing is mined. The corresponding patent map is drawn, issues related to research Linear motor technology in the global scope of the patent layout, key technology and research focus are studied. The technology industry development trend, key technology areas and competition mechanisms are analyzed, in order to draw valuable conclusions on the industry development. According to international patent IPC technical classification, research focus in the linear motor technology mainly in machine tool body and Japan is still leading the technology in the field of linear motors in machine tools.

articleTitle: Dynamic load-carrying capacity analysis of space manipulators with joint friction
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to analyze dynamic load-carrying capacity (DLCC) of free-floating space manipulators (FFSM) considering the effects of nonlinear friction in the joints. The dynamics model of FFSM with a payload is established, in which joint friction torque is described by using LuGre friction model. On this basis, considering limitation of joint drive capacity, base attitude requirement and joint velocity limits, the computational methodology for analysis of DLCC is present for point-to-point task in joint space and trajectory tracking task. The effectiveness of proposed methodology is verified by simulation experiments and the DLCC characteristics of space manipulators with joint friction are analyzed.

articleTitle: Study on operation characteristics and structure optimization of backwater jet device for downcomer of hot water boiler
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: With the development of mechanics and automation, the compound circulation which is installed at the entrance of the boiler inlet pipe can greatly increase the circulating water velocity and reduce the subcooled boiling and oxygen corrosion of the boiler. But because of the complexity of the complex cycle and the difficulties in the test, many important laws can not be given. Through the computational fluid dynamics software (CFD), the numerical simulation of the working process of the jet device is carried out to improve the operating characteristics and optimize the structure of the jet device.

articleTitle: Design and application of truck-mounted rig for coalbed methane
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: The coal-bed methane can be a security risk in mining process if the coalbed methane resources outburst from the coal seam. The treatment of coalbed methane resources in the early stage of coal mining is not only a safe and efficient treatment of coal mine, but also brings clean and efficient energy. The development of coalbed methane resources is paid more and more attention by the government. In view of the current large-scale exploitation of coal-bed methane resources, the development of a coalbed methane drilling to meet the requirements of the drilling rig. The rig uses a highly integrated approach that integrates the required functions on the chassis of the vehicle to meet the needs of rapid installation and transitions. Drilling control system uses hydraulic control and electro-hydraulic control dual control mode, can achieve short-range and remote control operations. Through the experiment, it is shown that the rig can meet the construction of the majority of coalbed methane drilling rigs in the country and the performance is stable and the operation is simple.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of manufactring system based on fault correlation
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: The multi-state manufacturing system was used to study the influence of the system performance on the reliability of the system, such as the performance status of the manufacturing system, the influence degree of the fault correlation, the complexity of the reliability analysis process and the reliability of the system. The performance of the unit was analyzed by Markov theory, and the structural decomposition of the polymorphic manufacturing system was carried out according to the fault correlation. The Copula function and the gray model were used to quantitatively analyze the influence of the failure correlation, and the fault correlation coefficient and the correlation coefficient between the subsystems and the units related to the existence of faults was given. The performance function of the polymorphic manufacturing system based on the fault correlation coefficient was given. Using the mapping method from the unit to the system, Fault-related performance of the performance of the function was obtained, and the system reliability model was built to achieve the reliability of the entire polymorphic system analysis.

articleTitle: Dynamic modeling of the towed fish system in variable ambient condition
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: The objective of the paper is to develop a mathematical model for reliable prediction of the dynamic behaviour of a towed modular system against variable ambient conditions. The developed model is a first step towards depiction of tow shape and drag forces acting on the towed system, comprising of a heavy tow cable and an electro active polymer actuated tow fish. Initially, towed module for the presented model is chosen to make it comparable to a previously developed model. Finally, the developed model is validated by comparing its numerical results to a fairly developed finite element code, previously presented in literature. Furthermore, the present study aims to address two important ambient factors, i.e. variant water current and density, in a numerical approach. Finally, similar modelling approach is adopted to predict the tow shape of the towing system, used for the tow fish, and tension exerted by the system on the towing vessel is also depicted.

articleTitle: Hybrid data fidelity, weighted difference of TV norms, model and algorithm for noisy image deblurring
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: Although difference of convex model has attracted many research efforts due to its superior performance for image processing, no attention has focused on robust data fidelity for this model. In this paper, we propose a novel model, which combines the l1 and l2 fidelity terms with a weighted difference of anisotropic and isotropic total variation (TV). Since our model takes a new difference form of convex terms, we employ difference of convex algorithm (DCA). In this paper, we adopt the augmented Lagrangian method (ALM) to solve each DCA subproblem of the proposed model, which is named as DCAALM. Experimental results on image deblurring demonstrate that the proposed methods outperform other competing methods in terms of quantitative criteria and perceptual quality.

articleTitle: Design of radar antenna based on HFSS
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: In this paper, a millimeter-wave radar array antenna with practical application is designed. According to the requirements of practical application of the speed radar, the actual detection range and return loss characteristics of the radar antenna are very demanding. At this request, the radar antenna array arrangement, through the power distributor to allocate the current of the single-patch antenna, and through the application of U shaped slot change the return loss, the application of HFSS software simulation analysis of the parameters of the antenna. At the same time the application of a variety of equipment testing and the actual road vehicle speed test, to meet the design requirements of the microstrip array antenna.

articleTitle: A robotic tour guide using a NAO T14 humanoid with a wheeled mobile platform
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: A NAO humanoid T14 model is employed to perform the functionalities of a tour guide for a college of engineering building. A wheeled mobile platform is designed and implemented to allow the robot to navigate. The software framework is developed to support a database of room descriptions, room number recognition, speech/gestures throughout the tour, as well as remote control of motion and live streaming of video captured by the robot to provide virtual tours. Future research on the tour guide robot is presented. This multi-year project provides opportunities for undergraduate students to conduct practical robotics research.

articleTitle: Preliminary study of salient region SLAM
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: This paper gives a study of visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (v-SLAM) based on Salient Region (SR) tracking. The SR tracking in this context is a kernel-based tracking approach, with which a local scene tracking is reached out for the proposed SLAM framework instead of using sparse features that largely adopted in existing studies. The SR tracking is simply used to track a block determined by salient region detection approach around the view center. In this case, tracking is basically independent from other tasks of the SLAM, and it is possible to consider both semi-direct methods relied on feature points and direct approaches. This paper gives a preliminary study to solve visual SLAM and give a more intuitive description of the scene. An experimental result is given to show how this idea works.

articleTitle: Research on speed and torque parameter adaptive control system of permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is a multivariable, nonlinear and strongly coupled system. It is difficult to achieve the ideal control effect by using the basic proportional integral (PI) control method in the process of speed change and load disturbance. In this paper, an adaptive PI parameter control strategy for speed and torque is proposed. First, the optimal control parameters are obtained by the iterative learning. Then, the Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System(ANFIS) learns from iterative learning results to achieve the system membership function parameters and control rules adjustment. Finally, the simulation results show that the system is characterized by high efficiency, high speed, high accuracy, small static response error, less response time and small overshoot. It is suitable for each torque transition and different operating speeds, which is superior to the basic PI control and fuzzy PI control with high control precision, good dynamic performance and strong anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Function-shape-based particle swarm optimization and its application in maritime static target cooperative search
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: The application of particle swarm algorithm in optimization has been growing over the last few years, but this approach becomes computationally impracticable when the complexity of the problem increases. In this context, an improvement of the particle swarm algorithm-the function-shape-based particle swarm optimization (FSPSO) is presented. For a practical maritime cooperative search problem, FSPSO makes particles move around in the corresponding solution space according to certain rules to gather information firstly. Then FSPSO exploits the history data acquired during the first process to analyze the shape of the solution space. Based on the knowledge about the function shape, FSPSO generates solutions and iteration strategies. At last, the position and speed of each particle will be updated iteratively, aiming at producing a high quality solution to the optimization problem. The main idea behind FSPSO is to hybridize PSO with the search mode of a human being. This paper uses maritime static target cooperative search as a test domain. In order to evaluate the effectiveness of FSPSO, we perform a comparison between the performances of FSPSO with other approaches drawn from the scientific literature. Results demonstrate that FSPSO is able to produce statistically significantly higher quality solutions, outperforming many other approaches.

articleTitle: Ensemble based support vector clustering
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: Hyper-plane based Support Vector Machine (SVM) for classification and hyper-spherical based Support Vector Data Description (SVDD) for clustering have been shown to be very effective in many real-world machine learning problems in various domains. Support vector clustering (SVC) based on SVDD has been successfully used to achieve robust clustering. However, in most cases, it is not possible to choose the best of input parameter values for an input dataset which restricts the application of SVC. Only a few heuristic approaches have been proposed to set the different parameters of these methods in an unsupervised manner. In this paper, we propose an ensemble based clustering approach to tackle the automatic parameter estimation problem for SVC in a fully unsupervised manner which is capable of producing robust clustering results. The experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation on movement of air cushion vehicle based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: The Air Cushion Vehicle (ACV, also called hovercraft) is greatly influenced by the environment when it is sailing at sea, and it has serious nonlinearity and large inertia. So it is difficult to establish accurate mathematical model. Because of the nonlinear mapping ability of neural networks, the neural network is used to identify the motion model of ACV. The comparison tests between the network model and the simulation model are carried out, and the results verify the feasibility of using the neural network to establish the aerodynamic model of ACV.

articleTitle: Study on roughness measurement model based on effect precision
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: Variable precision rough set is an effective method to deal with uncertain information and eliminate noise data. It introduces approximate precision on the basis of Pawlak rough set, no longer pursues accuracy, reduces the fitting degree of data, and solves the interference of noise data better. It is the foundation of many complex decision problems. It is of great theoretical and practical value to construct a rough measure reflecting different decision consciousness. In this paper, by analyzing the characteristics and shortcomings of the variable precision roughness measurement method, the concept of synthetic effect function is proposed. Then, the roughness measurement model based on the effect precision is established (EPRD), and its basic properties are discussed; further the attribute reduction method based on EPRD is proposed (EPRD-RM); finally the connection and difference between EPRD-RM and the existing reduction methods are analyzed by UCI data sets.

articleTitle: Robust fuzzy controller design for model-based discrete ship steering systems subject to multiple variance constraints
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: This paper presents a fuzzy controller design method based on Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy model for controlling the Nomoto's ship steering systems with nonlinearities. The state variance and output variance constraints are considered for the stochastic behaviors in Nomoto's ship steering model. Also, the state uncertain dynamic is considered, which can be solved by robust control theory. In this paper, a controller is designed by parallel distributed compensation method with satisfying the Lyapunov stability conditions and multiple variance constraints. Finally, the stability conditions are effectively solved by recasting into so-called linear matrix inequality problems. At last, a simulation is provided for the nonlinear ship steering systems whenever the external disturbances and perturbations exist.

articleTitle: Ship's trajectory planning for collision avoidance at sea based on modified artificial potential field
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: This paper presents an autonomous trajectory planning algorithm for ships or unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) to navigate safely in dynamic environments based on the modified artificial potential field (APF). The algorithm not only addresses collision avoidance (CA) for stationary and moving hazards, but also applies the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea (known as COLREGS, for COLlision REGulationS). Furthermore, the algorithm is still effective for the USV to prevent a collision once other ships disregard their responsibility under COLREGS. Assumptions, a concise description of the method developed and results of simulated navigational situations are included. The developed solution can be applied in decision support systems on board a ship or in an intelligent Obstacle Detection and Avoidance system.

articleTitle: 3D LiDAR-based point cloud map registration: Using spatial location of visual features
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: In this paper, a novel approach for the registration method of 3D point cloud maps is presented. During the operation of unmanned system, the construction of 3D maps for the environment is an important prerequisite for many navigation tasks. Generally 3D maps are widely utilized to recognize the location of the unmanned agent. Traditional map aligning techniques that use ICP (Iterative Closest Point) method relate points having the closest distance in different cloud maps in order to combine and extend the 3D maps. The method can be easily adopted in registration among sparse point cloud maps or consecutive scanning problems. However, this approach takes long computation time when aligning large scale maps including a lot of points. Therefore, an improved 3D point cloud map registration method is proposed to register precisely and effectively two maps using low-cost cameras. By combining odometry information derived from the SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) procedure and the 3D position of the selected image feature points, location of the coexisting places in both maps are extracted. Then, the estimation of rigid body transform between the origins of each map is achieved. The effectiveness of the presented method is quantitatively validated by experiment on challenging instances of the merging problem and comparison with an existing registration method.

publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Robotics and Automation Engineering (ICRAE)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: robot system design; robot system control; mobile robot motion planning; artificial intelligence; control theory; control engineering; intelligent control system design; intelligent control system development; mechatronics; electrical automation; mechanical engineering; manufacturing systems; image processing; machine vision; visualization; and electronic information technology.
